title: AEGIS configuration, version 1
description: The single source of truth for AEGIS configuration (AEGIS-231). Both the Python reference loader (python/common/config.py) and the C++ loader (cpp/common/config.hpp) validate against this file; there is no second copy of these rules to fall out of step with it.

config_version.description: Schema version this document targets. Mandatory and enumerated: a document written against a future schema must be rejected, never silently interpreted under the old rules.

experiment_id.description: Immutable identifier for this run. The same value appears in every log record and message envelope, so an artifact can be traced back to the run that produced it (AEGIS-209, AEGIS-232).

seed.description: Random seed. Recorded rather than defaulted, because an unrecorded seed makes a research result unreproducible (AEGIS-097, AEGIS-214).

format.description: Only JSON Lines is supported: logs must be machine-readable for AEGIS-232, and a human-formatted alternative would immediately become the one used in anger.
